# Three.js

Version: 0.185.1, distributed from the `three` npm package.
Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
License: MIT (see LICENSE).

The two minified ES modules are unmodified upstream builds. They are only
imported when the Pomodoro panel opens, not on initial page load. Update the
version in scripts/security-check.js when upgrading this dependency.
